calls.head: Two of the league’s busiest games meet
calls.body: Buffalo’s games average 84.2 unblocked shots per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams combined (6th of 32 for pace); Columbus’s average 84.5 (4th).
calls.call: The game runs at more than the two teams’ usual 84.3 unblocked shots per 60 at 5-on-5.

calls.happened: The game ran at 62.4 unblocked shots per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams combined, against the two teams’ usual 84.3 and a league average of 81.7.

calls.head: Buffalo kills penalties far better than Columbus
calls.body: On penalty kill, Buffalo sits 16th of 32, at the airtight end of the scale. Columbus is 32nd, at the leaky end.
calls.call: Buffalo’s penalty kill allows less per 60 than Columbus’s.

calls.happened: On expected goals allowed per 60 on the penalty kill, Buffalo had 10.7 per 60 and Columbus 7.5 per 60. Coming in, Buffalo was at 7.5 per 60 and Columbus at 8.5 per 60.

BUF.head: We had this close to even (49% for Buffalo), and it went Columbus’s way.

surprises.head: A rough night for U. Luukkonen
surprises.body: U. Luukkonen allowed 5 goals on shots worth 2.2 expected goals, 2.8 more than expected. Starting goalies had a night this rough about once every 25 starts over the last three seasons.

surprises.head: Columbus brought the hits
surprises.body: Columbus’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 163, against its usual 99 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 25 games.
